members.name: Sri Satish Sapparad
members.aboutText: Sri Satish Sapparad is currently serving as the President of Ilkal Co-Operative Bank Ltd. With a strong background in public service and community development, he brings a wealth of experience to the bank.
members.description: Sri Satish Sapparad is a respected leader with a clear vision for cooperative banking.

members.name: Sri Mahantesh Kampli
members.aboutText: Sri Mahantesh Kampli is currently serving as the Vice President of Ilkal Co-Operative Bank Ltd. Known for his dedication to public service and community development, he contributes significantly to the bank’s growth and strategic initiatives.
members.description: Sri Mahantesh Kampli is a committed leader with strong administrative and cooperative banking experience.
